title: Theni’s 3,000-year-old burial site throws light on ancient astronomy

title: Indian Scientists Discover Rare Stellar Fossil from the Early Universe
description: Ancient metal-poor stars that formed from this enriched gas preserve these chemical signatures and therefore act as "stellar fossils," allowing astronomers to reconstruct the history of the early Universe. Hence the discovery of such a rare stellar fossil provides important clues to the nucleosynthesis processes that enriched the primordial Universe and shaped the chemical evolution of our Galaxy.
